instruction: Create a floorplan with a core utilization of 0.7 and a core offset of 10 microns on all sides.
How do I set the aspect ratio of the die to 0.8 during floorplanning?
rag_answer:
Use the following command to create a floorplan with an aspect ratio of 0.8:  
```
icc2_shell> initialize_floorplan -core_utilization 0.7 -shape R \ -orientation N -side_ratio {1.0 0.8} -core_offset {100.0} \ -flip_first_row true  -coincident_boundary true
```
